caption: The drawing depicts a single wrought iron object positioned in the center of a plain, beige background. The object consists of two intertwined, dark brown or black twisted rods that spiral upward and join at the top. The base of the object splits into three curved legs, each leg splaying outward and curving slightly at the ends to provide support. The rods have a helical twist along their length. The top ends in a circular, flower-like or petal-shaped design. The artwork is minimal, with no additional objects or decorations. There is a small printed area near the bottom with the text "DEL. NZA JOHN PETRUCCI" indicating the creator. Some small, scattered brownish spots appear on the background, mostly near the edges and bottom right corner.
title: Rush Holder
